scenes.text: A proportion states that two ratios are equal. Keep the unit rate constant when scaling.
If 2 books cost Ghana cedis 10, how much do 4 books cost? The answer is 20. Multiply by 2: 10 times 2 equals 20.
7 exercise books cost Ghana cedis 42. At the same unit price in a recycling club, how much do 42 books cost? Pause to choose and explain.
7 exercise books cost Ghana cedis 42. At the same unit price in a recycling club, how much do 42 books cost? The answer is 252. The cost of one is Ghana cedis 6; 42 cost Ghana cedis 252.
